ns2:course.label: Trends and Issues in Math Edu
ns2:course.description: Addresses theories of learning, research studies, curriculum development projects, and other factors that have influenced elementary mathematics programs; also considers problems and issues in contemporary programs. Prerequisite: CI 500 or CI 520 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CI 500 or CI 520 or consent of instructor.
